title: UppASD benchmark case manifest (v1)
description: Declarative description of one benchmark case: an immutable production input template plus the legal variants, size ladder, allow-listed input overrides and workload-metadata hook that turn it into a scalable benchmark family. See benchmarks/cases/README.md and docs/UppASD Production Benchmark Framework.md section 17-18 (WP-02). A case manifest never contains generated data and never grants the harness license to rewrite arbitrary input parameters.

input_key.description: One UppASD inpsd.dat keyword, e.g. Nstep, ncell, tseed, temp, avrg_step.

override_value.description: A scalar override value, or a fixed-length array for a vector keyword such as ncell.

overrides.description: Input keyword overrides that define this variant, e.g. a temperature. Every key must also appear in allowed_input_overrides.

replication.description: [Nx, Ny, Nz] supercell replication counts, in the order the case's scalable_dimensions declares them.
[Nx, Ny] replication counts; thickness (thickness_cells) is fixed by the case and not a scaled dimension.
Explicit legal replication tuple; length and meaning are case-specific and must match scalable_dimensions.

id.description: Case identifier. Matches TERMINOLOGY.md case_id and the directory this manifest lives in.

infrastructure_test_only.description: True only for the one tiny synthetic case that exercises this framework's own machinery. Such a case may never enter an authoritative campaign report.

template_directory.description: Path to the immutable input template, relative to this manifest file. The harness only ever reads from here; it copies the template into a generated per-run work directory before any execution.

workload_class.description: Case-level interaction-range classification (blueprint section 3/5). Distinct from, and coarser-grained than, the per-record workload_class enum in benchmark_record.v1.schema.json, which this maps onto: *_neighbor -> NEIGHBOR_LIST, fft_dipole -> FFT_DIPOLE, neighbor_plus_dipole -> NEIGHBOR_LIST_PLUS_FFT_DIPOLE.

scalable_dimensions.description: Names of the dimensions each size's replication tuple varies, in order. 3D bulk: [Nx, Ny, Nz]. 2D: [Nx, Ny] with fixed thickness. case_specific: whatever the case's legal replication tuple actually means.

thickness_cells.description: Fixed out-of-plane replication for a 2D case. Required when dimensionality is 2D, absent otherwise.

sizes.description: The case's legal size ladder (TERMINOLOGY.md SIZE). Every entry's replication must be consistent with dimensionality and scalable_dimensions.

expected_physics.description: Documentation of the physics this case represents, so overrides can be audited against intent. Never machine-enforced beyond the allow-list.

allowed_input_overrides.description: Closed list of inpsd.dat keywords this case permits the harness to change. Every key here must also belong to the harness-wide safe-override vocabulary (harness.overrides.GLOBALLY_SAFE_OVERRIDE_KEYS); the case list only narrows that set further, it never widens it. A key absent from this list can never be overridden for this case, regardless of what a campaign or CLI invocation requests.

workload_metadata_method.description: Name of the registered workload-metadata parser (benchmarks/harness/workload_metadata.py) used to determine natom/directed_interactions/mean_neighbors/max_neighbors (neighbour cases) or natom/fft_grid (dipole/FFT cases) for a generated run. Must not estimate from assumptions when production input/output can supply the real value.

allOf.$comment: A 2D case fixes its out-of-plane thickness and scales exactly [Nx, Ny].
A 3D bulk case scales exactly [Nx, Ny, Nz] and has no separate fixed thickness.
Neighbour-family cases report neighbour-list workload metadata.
